_about: Small-office starting points. 'users' is how many people send a request at the same moment, not head count; the presets assume about a quarter to a third of staff hit enter at the same moment, so change users to match your office. 'context' is the window each user gets; 'prompt' is a typical request size.

presets.name: Solo / owner
presets.use: drafting emails, quick questions, summarizing a page or two

presets.name: 5-person office
presets.use: shared chat assistant, email drafts, meeting notes

presets.name: 25-person office
presets.use: everyone has a chat window open during the day

presets.name: Document review (law, accounting)
presets.use: reading whole contracts, leases, or statements of 30-60 pages

presets.name: Small dev team
presets.use: code assistant with a few files in context
